name: Zephaniah
summary: A prophet, the son of Cushi, who warned in the days of King Josiah that the day of the LORD was near and told the meek to seek the LORD. Scripture tells nothing more about him, and no story places him with anyone else.

key_moments.title: Warns the Day of the LORD Is Near
key_moments.description: Zephaniah said the LORD would stretch out His hand on Judah and Jerusalem and cut off those who worshipped Baal and the host of heaven. The great day of the LORD was near, a day of wrath, and silver and gold would not save them.

key_moments.title: Tells the Meek to Seek the LORD
key_moments.description: Zephaniah called the nation to gather before the LORD's fierce anger came. He told the meek of the earth to seek the LORD, righteousness and meekness, so they might be hidden in the day of His anger.

key_moments.title: Says the LORD Will Rejoice Over Zion
key_moments.description: Zephaniah told Zion to sing and Jerusalem to rejoice, for the LORD had cast out her enemy. The LORD in her midst would save, rejoice over her with singing, and gather His scattered people home.
